_comment: Example output of a competitor research agent (task DR-1-14/DR-1-15): a REFRESH of three Cloudflare values that went stale. Push with: node scripts/agent_ingest.js data/examples/competitor_research_cloudflare_refresh.json --as Kanishk. Everything arrives as origin=agent, status Draft, UNVERIFIED; a different person must verify it. 'supersedes' links retire the stale values when the new ones are verified. The numbers are invented for the prototype (Sahayogi CDN is hypothetical).
